I am sitting here thinking about this year's planting. My body is not as strong as before, and with just me in the household, I must think carefully about what I can manage alone.

My land is 10.1 mu. Last year cotton did alright, price was not bad, so I will keep cotton as my main crop. I plan to give cotton about 6 mu — it is what I know best after 40 years, and the machinery services in our village can help with the heavy work. Chili I will plant on 2.5 mu. Chili brings good money if the price holds, but it takes a lot of picking work. I cannot do more than 2.5 mu alone. The rest, 1.6 mu, I will plant mungbean. Mungbean does not need much care, and it rests the soil — old people in our village always said beans make the land fatter.

For **cotton**, I will buy improved hybrid seed from the agricultural supply store — the Bt type that resists bollworm, everyone around me uses it. I will apply about 2 bags of compound fertilizer (one bag 50 jin) before planting, that gives me roughly 18 kg nitrogen, 9 kg phosphorus, 9 kg potassium per mu. I topdress with urea when flowering starts. I will irrigate from the well 3 times — before planting, at budding, and at boll-setting. Cotton always needs many pesticide sprays, I expect 6 times for aphids, mirids, and bollworm even with Bt seed. I use the small rotary cultivator, plough every 2-3 years. I hope for 270 kg seed cotton per mu, like last year.

For **chili**, I plant improved seed from the dealer — long red type that dries well. Chili is hungry, so I put more fertilizer, about 22 kg N, 12 kg P, 18 kg K per mu, with farmyard manure mixed in if I have any. Chili needs water, I will irrigate 6 times from the well. Pests and disease come often on chili, I spray maybe 7 times. Plough deep before planting. If weather is good, 350 kg dried chili per mu is possible.

For **mungbean**, I use the local variety my neighbor shares — it is cheap and does well here. Mungbean does not need much fertilizer because the root makes its own nitrogen, I only put a little compound fertilizer, about 4 kg N, 6 kg P, 4 kg K. One irrigation at flowering if the rain fails. One or two sprays for aphids. Rotary till only. 130 kg per mu is a normal harvest.
